experiments.title: Week 1 · 4k context (truncation)
experiments.description: Smoke test, 5 tasks × 3 runs × 2 models, Ollama on a GTX 1650 (4 GB), default 4096-token context. In code_1 the history outgrew the context at step 5: Ollama silently cut the start of the conversation, cached tokens fell from 3,102 to 5 and TTFT rose from 6.1 s to 26.8 s (4.4×). Accuracy here is as originally graded (London accepted).

example.question: What is the sum of all prime numbers below 1000?

experiments.title: Week 1 · final (8k context + worked example)
experiments.description: Smoke test, 5 tasks × 3 runs × 2 models, Ollama on a GTX 1650 (4 GB), 8192-token context and a worked example in the system prompt. About 80% of every prompt repeats the previous step and Ollama serves about 85% of prompt tokens from its cache; the LLM takes 85-93% of the time.

example.question: In which year was the Eiffel Tower completed?

experiments.title: Weeks 2-3 · HotpotQA + GSM8K
experiments.description: 100 HotpotQA and 100 GSM8K tasks, llama3.2:3b on Ollama (GTX 1650): time split, context growth, prefix reuse and latency.

example.question: What giant silverware company was started as a religious Utopian group and was for many years run by Pierrepont Noyes?

experiments.title: Week 4 · Prefix caching, GSM8K
experiments.description: Same 100 GSM8K tasks on llama.cpp with prompt caching on and off (llama3.2:3b, GTX 1650).

example.question: Mark is trying to choose between two venues for a surprise party for his wife.  The first venue charges a flat fee of $200, regardless of how many guests attend.  While the second charges, $25 per person who attends.  However, the first venue does not include food, which Mark estimates will cost $5 for each person who attends.  At the second venue, food for each guest is already included in the price.  How many guests are necessary for the two venues to be equal in cost?

experiments.title: Week 4 · Prefix caching, HotpotQA
experiments.description: Same 100 HotpotQA tasks on llama.cpp with prompt caching on and off (llama3.2:3b, GTX 1650).

example.question: What city did the Freebooters F.C. soccer team lose in that is now known as Croke Park?

experiments.title: Week 5 · Concurrent agents
experiments.description: 1, 2, 4 and 8 agents in parallel on one llama.cpp server (16k-token shared KV cache), 100 GSM8K tasks each. Charts show the first three runs; the table shows all.

example.question: Richard, Jerry, and Robert are going to share 60 cherries. If Robert has 30 cherries, and has 10 more than Richard, how many more cherries does Robert have than Jerry?

experiments.title: Week 5 · Context truncation
experiments.description: HotpotQA with the full history vs. only the last 2 steps (cache on). Truncation shortens prompts but breaks the cached prefix.

example.question: What city did the Freebooters F.C. soccer team lose in that is now known as Croke Park?
